protocol.scope: Paired bounded first-party Software tasks; no arbitrary repository repair or LLM claim
protocol.budget: Calls, wall time, cost and source Task max_steps bound the whole episode. Nodes/depth/width remain per search, matching Runtime.
protocol.order: Rotate conditions by seed and reverse on second repeat; fresh World/Store/Registry/Agent each episode
protocol.comparison: Actions, authoritative execution observations, reward-independent success/unsafe and aligned learning labels; audit original Gate hashes and complete receipts before semantic normalization
protocol.limitations: Two-step checkout plus two one-step programs; no target throughput, reward or long-term intelligence metric; native task proposals already repair these tasks

authority_audit: Original Gate policy/evidence hashes, ordered authorization/intent/outcome, complete receipt, input State/Action and horizon-1 learning checked in every episode
